title: Fast assistants per context
text: All right, so I believe we did a research task about using uh, using the um, open router stuff, right? So what I want you to do is spawn a minion, and it it could be it could use the same work tree if it still exists. Um, but what I want you to do is to look at that research process. From like a fresh angle and think you know what was asked what was done and how did the research process actually work and so i don't know if the Cervex mastermind should be a part of this um in terms of updating the actual skill system like the Cervex mastermind seems to be the one who's got the context to uh get that done properly um but you know i, I was asking about getting the research process kind of baked into this AI process for any Uh, for any card, for any page, for whatever context, you know, we're, we're going to, uh, well, and okay, another thing I was just thinking that the Cervex Mastermind should think about is do we need and should we be creating fast assistance for every new kind of context, session context, or however we're describing this? Um, you know, the fast assistant needs to be fast and so can't get bogged down in, you know, other tasks or whatever. And so you, You kind of want a fast assistant for every context. However, um, we don't need to keep them running. So I'm not sure how that works in the SDK. I've seen these idle agents, you know, on lots of screens. It uh, seems like maybe that's just, um, maybe, maybe there's a small piece of in-memory like structure in the JavaScript SDK that, you know, can tap into that idle agent and reuse it, but at pretty low cost. We might need to purge those at some point if we're, you know, working across a lot of different pages and start spawning hundreds of fast assistants. I guess the alternative is to recycle them or, well, but the thing is, if you, if you kind of, if you do, well, you don't want, you don't want to have context bloat. So you kind of want to start fresh. And so it seems like starting a new, you know, fast assistant for a new kind of context mean is exactly what, you know, well, whether we pre-make them or make them, I think making them on demand. So only when, you know, like the dictate button is pushed, then if there isn't currently a fast assistant, we make one. Um, I don't think we need to, every time a new page is made, we automatically uh, create, you know, a bunch of agents that just sit around and potentially never do anything. So, you know, add that to, well, send that, that, you know, issue through to the uh, system designer so we can at least make note and try and optimize for that.
